key.name: owner-filters
key.description: JSON list of monitored accounts, organizations, and repository selections.

key.name: owner-filters-configured
key.description: Distinguishes the initial all-accessible scope from an intentionally empty selection.

key.name: author-filter
key.description: GitHub login to monitor; @me is the default and empty includes every author.

key.name: quick-open-shortcut
key.description: Opens the menu with the issue and pull request field focused; empty disables it.

key.name: recent-repositories
key.description: JSON list of repositories recently opened from quick open, newest first.

key.name: claude-quota-enabled
key.description: Reads the Claude subscription usage through claude -p /usage.

key.name: codex-quota-enabled
key.description: Reads the Codex rate limits through codex app-server.

key.name: agy-quota-enabled
key.description: Reads the Antigravity Gemini quota through agy -p /usage.

key.name: agent-quota-interval
key.description: Time between agent quota checks, in minutes.

key.name: agent-quota-threshold
key.description: A quota window notifies once per period when its usage reaches this percentage.

key.name: agent-quota-cache
key.description: Local data: each provider's last reading and the periods already notified.

key.name: state-cache
key.description: Local data used to detect new green check runs.

key.name: last-filter
key.description: Stored so changing filters establishes a quiet notification baseline.

key.name: initialized
key.description: Prevents startup notifications for pull requests that are already green.
